patterns: Reboot/casting news with creator-economy cast (BAYWATCH with Livvy Dunne, Noah Beck) — 6.4M views, day's top post
Sexiest Man Alive tease then reveal (Noah Wyle) — 4.0M + 1.17M — debate bait
Creator explains hidden meaning (Brad Bird on THE INCREDIBLES powers) — 921k views, 42k likes, best like rate
DUNE: PART 3 wave: cast trailer reactions, 'first and last' character posters, final poster and final trailer
Anniversary + restoration hooks (Y TU MAMA TAMBIEN 25th, 4K) — 875k
Celebrity photoshoot carousels (Jennifer Lawrence for The Cut) — 225k
Archival talk-show and behind-the-scenes clips (Pitt/Fallon, Spielberg 1992, Scorsese on JAWS) for ATRightMovies
Short vague hook + video ('Bring Back the R-Rated Comedy', 'A Film I Cannot Wait To See') — CinemaTweets1's top two

no_hits.reason: No original posts in the last 24h.

narrative_synthesis: Casting and celebrity reveals drove the day: the Baywatch reboot look hit 6.4M on DiscussingFilm and People's Sexiest Man Alive tease hit 4.0M on FilmUpdates. Dune: Part 3 dominated volume ahead of and through today's final trailer drop, and Brad Bird's Incredibles explainer had the strongest likes-to-views ratio.
